notes:
• Series: Netflix, HBO, Prime Video, Disney+ and Hulu moved into the Categories sidebar under NETWORKS
• Network grids now fill to 70 shows, laid out 7 across
• Fixed the black backdrop on Movies and Series heroes — if the full-size image fails, it falls back to a smaller size instead of black
• Sports row removed from Home — Sports lives only in the Sports section
• Sports Centre: a sidebar lists every league, and league settings inside Sports let you choose which leagues and competitions appear
• Match channel lists no longer include “usually shows” channels — only channels confirmed for that game
• Channel previews now play with sound on by default
• Clicking a show opens its detail screen — backdrop, cast with character names, director, ratings and overview, plus a Trailer button that plays in the app; episode lists show each episode's synopsis
• Clicking a movie plays it right away again — the movie detail screen lives on its ••• menu (hold OK on the poster)
• Detail screens now show IMDb and Rotten Tomatoes scores beside the existing rating (scores from MDBList)
• VPN in Settings → Network: Proton with just a username and password (14 free servers), or your own WireGuard config
• Subtitles: sign in with a free OpenSubtitles account (Settings → Content & metadata), then Add subtitles in the player finds subtitles for movies and shows
